what: For the graph at rest (docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/graph.md section 3): (1) a frozen variant of the query origin in zalsa_local.rs whose edges are read through graph::frozen::Overlay (node -> FrozenGraph::edges) instead of an EdgeSpan, so a restart maps the image; (2) an Ingredient hook enumerating each live function memo as (node, edge words) so graph::frozen::write can take a Source over the live Graph; (3) at Graph::compact, apply graph::order::dfs_preorder to the live columns (node keys, key table, colors, MemoHeader.node, task node caches, bloom column words via bloom::renumber_word) so deep verify reads colors in walk order.

history.note: Items 2 and 3 written blind by sol-salsa-order (/tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-sol-salsa-order.md). Item 2: Ingredient::memo_edges and graph::LiveEdges, also a frozen::Source, with Zalsa::freeze_graph. Item 3: Graph::compact_renumbered, called from Zalsa::compact_edges_if_worth_it, renames nodes, the key table, colors, edge words, MemoHeader.node and the bloom column (Closures::renumber); node caches drop by the Nodes epoch. Tests: tests/walk_order.rs plus unit tests. Bench: benches/verify_order.rs. Item 1, the frozen query origin, is parked until frontend-image restores memos onto frozen nodes.
